CR-3.title: Advance releases configuration admission before ApplyConfChange
CR-3.cause: Configuration admission compares pendingConfIndex against raftLog.applied, which Advance can move before the separate membership-application callback.

MC-1.title: Joint snapshot recovery drops the outgoing voter configuration
MC-1.cause: The V01 construction and restore paths rebuild configuration from Nodes and Learners only, omitting the persisted outgoing configuration and staged joint fields.

MC-2.title: Outgoing-only joint voter rejects a valid recovery snapshot
MC-2.cause: The live snapshot recipient check searches only incoming voters and current learners, omitting outgoing voters and staged learners that are full members of a joint ConfState.
